decision_basis: Negative FCF, financing prepayments, material net debt and equity funding outweigh rapid IaaS/operating growth. Actual debt reduction and 4.71x interest coverage temper the sell conviction, but 13.16x forecast earnings alone do not compensate observed funding dependence and future delivery commitments.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: quantified funding/dilution costs dominate current compensation, while operating improvement limits severity.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
